name: Crack a fetch on turn 1-2 for a basic that unlocks a hand card, never paying life
intent: On turn 1 or 2, once open-land-unlocks has had first refusal, play a fetch from hand and crack it for a library basic that unlocks some other hand card - Marsh Flats found for a library Plains that lets Serra Ascendant be cast. orzhov-martyr never pays life for a land drop: Serra Ascendant and Martyr of Sands both care about this deck's own life total directly, so this play, unlike the shock-then-fetch pair the other three decks in this pass carry, never runs open-shock-unlocks at all and restricts its own fetch to a basic, answering pay_life false always. orzhov-martyr carries no basic Swamp and no basic Island at all, so Flooded Strand's Island half and Marsh Flats' Swamp half are both dead weight - neither fetch is more precious than the other here, and the prefer tier ({searches_for_any: [Plains]}) matches both, a deliberate no-op left to ties: any. The crack itself is restricted to an untapped source that can actually reach the unlock (searches_for_any plus unlocks_by_search), so a stale fetch already on the battlefield that cannot reach the needed land is never cracked in place of the one that can. Stands down once open-land-unlocks would already fire (U's own key), the library is down to 5 cards or fewer, or life is 1 or less - the same guard dimir-frog's own F-basic carries, matched here for consistency even though this deck's own life-gain plan (Serra Ascendant, Martyr of Sands) makes 1 life a rarer spot to be in. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack.
